title: Services quote form: the three-step quote block from the Vanta design, used on govanta.pro/quote

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: build Vanta out fully from its design system; the design's Quote.jsx three-step form had no block (LIVE-2069 shipped a contact card in its place)

detail: Adds the ServicesQuote block (components/page-editor/blocks/services.tsx) and its client form (components/sites/services-quote-form.tsx): services and how often, then the place (address, property type, window count, inside and outside glass), then contact. It sends through submitContactForm (anonymous lead door, honeypot, rate limit) with every choice folded into the message. Styled in the Services sheet (sv-qf, tokens only). Vanta's /quote page uses it. The live Vanta document is updated to match once this deploys. Probe: node scripts/probes/services-quote-form.mjs.
